item.title: 1988 Mercedes-Benz 560SL at No Reserve
item.description: This 1988 Mercedes-Benz 560SL is finished in Anthracite Gray Metallic over Palomino leather and is powered by a 5.5-liter V8 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission. Features include a limited-slip differential, a black soft top, a removable hardtop, silver-finished 15" Gullideckel alloy wheels, fog lights, a cassette stereo, an alarm system, electric windows, central locking, and cruise control. item.title: 1995 Ford F-350 XLT SuperCab 7.5L Dually at No Reserve
item.description: This 1995 Ford F-350 XLT is a SuperCab dually pickup that has 94k miles after time in Washington, Oregon, California, and Nevada. Finished in Black Clearcoat over Opal Gray cloth, the truck is powered by a 7.5-liter Lima V8 that drives the rear wheels through a four-speed automatic transmission. Equipment includes clearance lights, 16" Alcoa eight-hole alloy wheels, front disc brakes, air conditioning, cruise control, a Pioneer CD stereo, and dual fuel tanks.
